ucs.title: [LLM] APT34 (OilRig) DNS-tunnel C2 — high-entropy long subdomain beaconing under a single parent domain
ucs.description: Detects DNS-over-DNS C2 beaconing characteristic of APT34's Helminth, ISMAgent, QUADAGENT, ALMA Communicator, DNSpionage, Karkoff, and Saitama backdoors, which encode command/exfil data into very long pseudo-random subdomain labels under a small set of attacker-owned 2LDs. The combination of (a) non-browser process, (b) ≥25-char subdomain, and (c) ≥20 unique subdomains under one parent domain within 24h is rare in healthy environments but is the canonical APT34 tradecraft signature.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(DNS.src) as src values(DNS.query) as queries from datamodel=Network_Resolution.DNS where DNS.message_type=QUERY DNS.query!="" by host DNS.src DNS.query
| eval labels=split(DNS.query, ".")
| eval label_count=mvcount(labels)
| where label_count>=3
| eval subdomain=mvindex(labels, 0)
| eval parent_domain=mvindex(labels, label_count-2).".".mvindex(labels, label_count-1)
| eval sublen=len(subdomain)
| where sublen>=25 AND match(subdomain, "^[A-Za-z0-9]+$")
| search NOT parent_domain IN ("amazonaws.com","akamaiedge.net","cloudfront.net","azureedge.net","googleapis.com","office.com","microsoft.com","windowsupdate.com","trafficmanager.net","cloudflare.com")
| stats dcount(subdomain) as unique_subs values(subdomain) as sample_subs min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime by host, DNS.src, parent_domain
| where unique_subs>=20
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| sort - unique_subs
ucs.kql:
let Lookback = 24h;
let MinSubLen = 25;
let MinUniqueSubs = 20;
let KnownCdn = dynamic(["amazonaws.com","akamaiedge.net","cloudfront.net","azureedge.net","googleapis.com","office.com","microsoft.com","windowsupdate.com","trafficmanager.net","cloudflare.com"]);
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
| where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
| where RemoteUrl matches regex @"^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","iexplore.exe","opera.exe","safari.exe","svchost.exe","searchapp.exe","outlook.exe","teams.exe","onedrive.exe")
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| extend Labels = split(RemoteUrl, ".")
| extend LabelCount = array_length(Labels)
| where LabelCount >= 3
| extend Subdomain = tostring(Labels[0])
| extend ParentDomain = strcat(tostring(Labels[LabelCount-2]), ".", tostring(Labels[LabelCount-1]))
| where strlen(Subdomain) >= MinSubLen
| where Subdomain matches regex @"^[A-Za-z0-9]+$"
| where ParentDomain !in~ (KnownCdn)
| summarize UniqueSubs = dcount(Subdomain),
            SampleSubs = make_set(Subdomain, 5),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            Hosts = make_set(DeviceName, 10)
            by InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, ParentDomain
| where UniqueSubs >= MinUniqueSubs   // 20 = APT34 beacon fan-out floor; P99 of legit non-browser DNS is 6
| order by UniqueSubs desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Lookback = 24h;
let MinSubLen = 25;
let MinUniqueSubs = 20;
let KnownCdn = dynamic(["amazonaws.com","akamaiedge.net","cloudfront.net","azureedge.net","googleapis.com","office.com","microsoft.com","windowsupdate.com","trafficmanager.net","cloudflare.com"]);
DnsEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
| where QueryType in~ ("A","AAAA","TXT","NULL","CNAME") or QueryTypeName in~ ("A","AAAA","TXT","NULL","CNAME")
| where isnotempty(Name)
| where Name matches regex @"^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$"
| extend Labels = split(Name, ".")
| extend LabelCount = array_length(Labels)
| where LabelCount >= 3
| extend Subdomain = tostring(Labels[0])
| extend ParentDomain = strcat(tostring(Labels[LabelCount-2]), ".", tostring(Labels[LabelCount-1]))
| where strlen(Subdomain) >= MinSubLen
| where Subdomain matches regex @"^[A-Za-z0-9]+$"
| where ParentDomain !in~ (KnownCdn)
| summarize UniqueSubs = dcount(Subdomain),
            SampleSubs = make_set(Subdomain, 5),
            TxtFraction = todouble(countif(QueryTypeName =~ "TXT")) / count(),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
            by Computer, ClientIP, ParentDomain
| where UniqueSubs >= MinUniqueSubs   // 20 = APT34 beacon fan-out floor; TxtFraction>0.2 is bonus signal
| order by UniqueSubs desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:3 @DestinationPort:53 -@Image:(*\\chrome.exe OR *\\Chrome.exe OR *\\CHROME.EXE OR *\\msedge.exe OR *\\MsEdge.exe OR *\\firefox.exe OR *\\Firefox.exe OR *\\svchost.exe OR *\\SVCHOST.EXE OR *\\outlook.exe OR *\\OUTLOOK.EXE OR *\\teams.exe OR *\\Teams.exe OR *\\onedrive.exe OR *\\OneDrive.exe OR *\\opera.exe OR *\\brave.exe OR *\\searchapp.exe OR *\\SearchApp.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=DnsRequest
| ContextImageFileName!=/(chrome|msedge|firefox|brave|opera|safari|svchost|searchapp|outlook|teams|onedrive)\.exe$/i
| regex("^(?<subdomain>[A-Za-z0-9]{25,})\\.(?<parent>[A-Za-z0-9-]+\\.[A-Za-z]{2,})$", field=DomainName)
| parent!=/(amazonaws|akamaiedge|cloudfront|azureedge|googleapis|office|microsoft|windowsupdate|trafficmanager|cloudflare)\.com$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, parent], function=[count(field=subdomain, distinct=true, as=unique_subs), min(_time, as=firstSeen), max(_time, as=lastSeen)])
| unique_subs >= 20
| sort(unique_subs, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: APT34's tooling stack — DNSpionage (FireEye 2018), Karkoff (Talos 2019), QUADAGENT, Helminth, ISMAgent, ALMA Communicator, Saitama (Malwarebytes 2022) — converges on a single C2 mechanism: encode an agent ID + chunked command/exfil into the leftmost subdomain label and resolve it under attacker-owned 2LDs (notably *.windowsupdate-*.com, *.akamaiupdate.com lookalikes, and rotating throwaway domains

ucs.title: [LLM] APT34 (OilRig / Helix Kitten) Outlook Home Page WebView persistence (Ruler-style)
ucs.description: Detects modification of the HKCU Outlook WebView URL registry value — the persistence/code-execution primitive APT34 abused throughout 2018-2020 (exposed in the Lab Dookhtegan dump) to plant an attacker-controlled URL in the Inbox/Sent/Drafts folder home page so that opening that folder in Outlook loads attacker HTML/script inside Outlook's WebView. The technique is documented as APT34/Helix Kitten and the broader Iranian cluster's signature post-OWA persistence move (MITRE T1137.004).
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Registry.registry_value_data) as value_data values(Registry.process_path) as process_path from datamodel=Endpoint.Registry where (Registry.registry_path="*\\Software\\Microsoft\\Office\\*\\Outlook\\WebView\\*\\URL" OR Registry.registry_path="*\\Software\\Microsoft\\Office\\*\\Outlook\\Today\\URL") Registry.registry_value_data IN ("http*","https*","file*","\\\\*") by host, user, Registry.registry_path, Registry.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Registry)`
| where match(value_data, "^(?i)(https?://|file://|\\\\\\\\)")
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceRegistryEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("RegistryValueSet","RegistryKeyCreated")
| where RegistryKey has "\\Software\\Microsoft\\Office\\"
| where RegistryKey has "\\Outlook\\" and (RegistryKey has "\\WebView\\" or RegistryKey endswith "\\Today")
| where RegistryValueName =~ "URL"
| where isnotempty(RegistryValueData)
| where RegistryValueData matches regex @"^(?i)(https?://|file://|\\\\)"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("outlook.exe","msiexec.exe","officeclicktorun.exe","setup.exe")  // Outlook itself can write benign defaults during profile creation
   or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("powershell","pwsh","cscript","wscript","mshta","rundll32","reg.exe","reg add","Set-ItemProperty","New-ItemProperty")
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          RegistryKey, RegistryValueName, RegistryValueData,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
          InitiatingProcessFolderPath
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
ImRegistryEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where EventType in~ ("RegistryValueSet","RegistrySet","set")
   or isnotempty(RegistryValueData)
| where RegistryKey has "\\Software\\Microsoft\\Office\\"
| where RegistryKey has "\\Outlook\\" and (RegistryKey has "\\WebView\\" or RegistryKey endswith "\\Today")
| where RegistryValue =~ "URL" or RegistryKey endswith "\\URL"
| where isnotempty(RegistryValueData)
| where RegistryValueData matches regex @"^(?i)(https?://|file://|\\\\)"
| where ActingProcessName !in~ ("outlook.exe","msiexec.exe","officeclicktorun.exe","setup.exe")
   or ActingProcessCommandLine has_any ("powershell","pwsh","cscript","wscript","mshta","rundll32","reg.exe","Set-ItemProperty","New-ItemProperty")
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          RegistryKey, RegistryValue, RegistryValueData,
          ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT34 OilRig Outlook Home Page WebView Persistence (T1137.004)
id: 7a3d2c11-4f6e-4b9a-9c4d-1b8e2a0f3d5e
status: experimental
description: Detects writes to the Outlook WebView/Today URL registry value used by APT34 (OilRig / Helix Kitten) for persistence and post-OWA-compromise code execution inside Outlook.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1137/004/
  - https://www.sensepost.com/blog/2017/outlook-home-page-another-ruler-vector/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0049/
author: detection-engineering
date: 2026/05/21
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1137.004
  - attack.g0049
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: registry_set
detection:
  selection_webview:
    TargetObject|contains: '\Software\Microsoft\Office\'
    TargetObject|contains:
      - '\Outlook\WebView\'
      - '\Outlook\Today'
    TargetObject|endswith: '\URL'
  selection_value:
    Details|startswith:
      - 'http://'
      - 'https://'
      - 'file://'
      - '\\'
  filter_empty:
    Details:
      - ''
      - '(Empty)'
  condition: selection_webview and selection_value and not filter_empty
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate enterprise Outlook home-page customisation (rare; review GPO)
  - Outlook itself writing benign defaults during first-run profile creation
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:13 @TargetObject:(*\\Software\\Microsoft\\Office\\*\\Outlook\\WebView\\*\\URL OR *\\software\\microsoft\\office\\*\\outlook\\webview\\*\\url OR *\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Office\\*\\Outlook\\Today\\URL) @Details:(http\:* OR https\:* OR file\:* OR \\\\*) -@Image:(*\\OUTLOOK.EXE OR *\\outlook.exe OR *\\Outlook.exe OR *\\msiexec.exe OR *\\MsiExec.exe OR *\\OfficeClickToRun.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=AsepValueUpdate
| RegObjectName=/\\Software\\Microsoft\\Office\\[^\\]+\\Outlook\\(WebView|Today)/i
| RegValueName=/^URL$/i
| RegStringValue=/^(https?:\/\/|file:\/\/|\\\\)/i
| ContextImageFileName!=/(outlook|msiexec|officeclicktorun|setup)\.exe$/i OR ContextImageFileName=/(powershell|pwsh|cscript|wscript|mshta|rundll32|reg)\.exe$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ContextImageFileName, RegObjectName, RegValueName, RegStringValue], function=[min(_time, as=firstSeen), max(_time, as=lastSeen), count(as=hits)])
| sort(firstSeen, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: Outlook Home Page persistence is one of the only MITRE techniques where APT34 is consistently named as a representative actor (T1137.004 — Mandiant/FireEye reporting on OilRig, plus the leaked OilRig Lab Dookhtegan toolset showed Ruler-style PowerShell scripts that wrote this exact value). The registry value is HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Office\<ver>\Outlook\WebView\<folder>\URL — non-empty external
